status: PROPOSAL — staged. Erik: 'every place needs to use something… extrapolate from there.'

theRule.statement: ⚠️ A PEOPLE'S MONEY IS WHAT THEIR CRAFT PRODUCES IN SURPLUS THAT OUTSIDERS CANNOT MAKE THEMSELVES.
theRule.derivation: Erik's three examples all obey it and I only had to notice: the Cogitants sell THINKING TIME (their surplus is analysis, which nobody else can do at their depth); the never-transitioned value PRE-TRANSITION CURRENCY AND NANITE TECH (their surplus is an intact old economy, their scarcity is the substrate they refused); the Churnfolk take GOLD AND FAVORS (a chaos-people cannot back a token with institutions, so they back it with metal that needs no institution — or with a debt that is personal).
corollaries: MONEY FOLLOWS SURPLUS, exactly as crime followed GATES in the villainy pass. Same generative move, and it produced 27 currencies with nothing invented.

A POLE'S MONEY IS ALWAYS SLIGHTLY DANGEROUS TO OUTSIDERS, because a surplus of one thing is a scarcity of its opposite — you are always paying in something they have too much of and receiving something you cannot get at home.
AND IT EXPLAINS THE GRADIENT WITHOUT RESTATING IT: the Reaches take only their own because a pure people's surplus is SO specialised that nothing else is commensurable with it.

byPole.whatItIs: a bounded piece of analysis, delivered. Erik's own example, and the cleanest case of the rule: their surplus is thinking, so thinking IS the coin.
byPole.whereItSpends: anywhere with a problem — which is everywhere, making cogitant money unusually portable
byPole.note: ⚠️ A CURRENCY THAT MUST BE SPENT ON SOMETHING SPECIFIC. You cannot hold a solved problem; you can only hold a PROMISE of one, which means cogitant money is really a claim on future attention. That is a genuinely different economic object from a coin, and it should FEEL different at the table.

byPole.whatItIs: a demonstrated conclusion others may cite. Adjacent to cogitant but colder: cogitants sell the solving, syllogists sell the SETTLED.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Reasoned Hold fully; the Lattice Cities honour it in contracts; nowhere that does not argue

byPole.whatItIs: Erik's example. Metal that needs no institution to be worth something, plus personal debt.
byPole.whereItSpends: widely, because gold is gold — but the FAVOR half only where you are known
byPole.note: ⚠️ THE REASON IS STRUCTURAL: a chaos-steeped people CANNOT back a token with institutions, because institutions are the thing they are steeped against. So they back it with metal (needs nobody) or with a favor (needs only two people). Erik gave the answer; the rule explains WHY it had to be that answer.

byPole.whatItIs: an entry in a ledger the Lattice Cities keep. Money as a RECORD rather than an object.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Lattice Cities and anywhere that honours their ledgers — which is further than you would think, because a good ledger is useful to everyone
byPole.note: The antipode pair does money too: churnfolk money needs NO institution, lattice money is NOTHING BUT institution. Neither can be spent in the other's country.

byPole.whatItIs: components that function, graded. The Gearlands' surplus is machinery that still runs.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Gearlands, the Crossing, and any salvage ring — the widest-spending of the material moneys

byPole.whatItIs: time in which someone genuinely attended to you. Their surplus is attention.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Numinous Reach only, and it does not travel at all
byPole.note: ⚠️ THE LEAST PORTABLE MONEY IN THE WORLD, and correctly so. You cannot carry an attended hour out of the Reach. A party that earns wealth here must SPEND it here — which is a beautiful trap and a very good reason to be careful what you accept.

byPole.whatItIs: living stock — a cutting from a proven tree, seed from a good year.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Quickwood and every growing place; worthless in the Palelands and the Gearlands

byPole.whatItIs: an obligation recorded against a death eased or a rot stopped. Paid in service, not goods.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Palelands; honoured warily elsewhere because nobody likes owing the Ashwardens

byPole.whatItIs: glass worked in true flame, which only the Blaze can make. A hard, portable, unfakeable token.
byPole.whereItSpends: widely — it is the most COIN-LIKE of the pole moneys because it is small, hard and hard to forge

byPole.whatItIs: a debt neither party will name aloud. Their surplus is discretion.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Umbral Depths, and quietly anywhere the Quiet Hands run
byPole.note: The exact inverse of lattice's registered claim: money that works ONLY because it is unrecorded. Writing it down destroys it.

byPole.whatItIs: a sworn term of service, transferable. Their surplus is capable violence.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Riven Marches and anywhere hiring; NOT honoured in Stillhold country, on principle

byPole.whatItIs: surety — a guarantee that a thing will not happen. Their surplus is credible restraint.
byPole.whereItSpends: wherever a truce is worth money, which is most contested ground
byPole.note: ⚠️ MY FAVOURITE DERIVED CURRENCY: you buy the ABSENCE of something. A Stillhold surety is worth most exactly where violence is likeliest, so its value RISES as a region worsens. An economy with a built-in tragedy.

byPole.whatItIs: dressed stone to a known standard. Heavy, honest, hard to fake.
byPole.whereItSpends: locally — it is the least portable HARD money, and mason towns are rich in a way you cannot carry

byPole.whatItIs: a drawn figure that does what it means, sold as an object.
byPole.whereItSpends: anywhere that trusts figures — and NOWHERE a Mason will look at it, since thingcraft denies abstraction purchase

byPole.whatItIs: a verified truth, witnessed. Their surplus is certainty.
byPole.whereItSpends: everywhere disputes exist; it is the most universally USEFUL money and the least commonly minted, because verists are few

byPole.whatItIs: an identity that will bear scrutiny. Their surplus is credible falsehood.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Veiled Reach and the criminal trades; possessing one is itself a crime elsewhere

byPole.whatItIs: a known safe passage, sold as knowledge. Their surplus is having been everywhere.
byPole.whereItSpends: widely and immediately — a route is worth something to anyone who must travel

byPole.whatItIs: the Kept Reach's own scrip, literally denominated in duration.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Kept Reach only; the Crossing takes it at a poor rate because nobody else can honour a duration

byPole.whatItIs: instruction — a technique taught, body to body. Their surplus is mastery.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Somatic Reaches; portable only inside the person who learned it
byPole.note: A currency that CANNOT BE STOLEN, only given. Worth flagging: it is the one money a bandit cannot take off you.

byPole.whatItIs: taking a measure of someone's weight, for a price. Their surplus is capacity to feel.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Feeling Coast; and the Kindness (the criminal trade) runs on exactly this, which is why it was so easy to author

byPole.whatItIs: goods, straight. The most ordinary money in the world and the most widely accepted.
byPole.whereItSpends: everywhere. Wright money is the closest the world has to a universal medium besides crystal

byPole.whatItIs: a promise to end a specific thing. Their surplus is careful destruction.
byPole.whereItSpends: narrowly, and every transaction is a small horror; nobody holds these long

byPole.whatItIs: a document conferring standing. Their surplus is legitimacy.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Ascent and everywhere that respects the Orders — WHICH IS THE LICENCE TRADE'S ENTIRE MARKET (my authored villainy runs on forging exactly this)

byPole.whatItIs: a bargain, transferable, and exactly fair. Their surplus is willingness to name a true price.
byPole.whereItSpends: the Descent and the Hollow Market; honoured elsewhere with dread

byPole.whatItIs: worked light in a keepable form. The foothill version of kindled glass: smaller, commoner, warmer.
byPole.whereItSpends: the foothills broadly — this is genuine folk money

byPole.whatItIs: an instrument or a tuning, sold. Foothill money, and a good one.
byPole.whereItSpends: the foothills and the Crossing

byPole.whatItIs: goods for goods, plus the Mark where standing is known. The near-centre generalist has the most ORDINARY money, exactly as it has the most ordinary crafts.
byPole.whereItSpends: everywhere at the centre; the Reaches take it poorly

theUntransitioned.money: PRE-TRANSITION CURRENCY AND NANITE TECHNOLOGY — Erik's own example
theUntransitioned.why: ⚠️ AND THE RULE EXPLAINS IT EXACTLY, which is how I know the rule is right. Their SURPLUS is an intact old economy — coin, paper, banks, records — that everyone else lost. Their SCARCITY is the substrate they refused. So they pay in the old money and they buy NANITE TECH AT ANY PRICE. THE CONSEQUENCE IS THE INTERESTING PART: to the Valley, a working nanite device is salvage. To them it is the thing they gave up their future to avoid and now cannot live without. A SALVAGE RING SELLING TO OUTLAND TRADERS IS SELLING PEOPLE THE THING THEY REFUSED. That is a trade route with a moral problem built into it, and it did not have to be invented.
theUntransitioned.andItPricesOldCoin: This is also WHY old coin has value in the Valley at all: it is not nostalgia, it is that the untransitioned still honour it, so old coin is really a claim on outland goods.

findings: ONE RULE GENERATED 27 CURRENCIES: a people's money is WHAT THEIR CRAFT PRODUCES IN SURPLUS THAT OUTSIDERS CANNOT MAKE THEMSELVES. Erik's three examples all obey it — cogitants sell thinking because thinking is their surplus; the untransitioned buy nanite tech because the substrate is their scarcity; the churnfolk use gold and favors because a chaos-people CANNOT back a token with institutions. I only had to notice the rule and run it out. Same generative move as 'crime follows gates' in the villainy pass.

THE ANTIPODE PAIRS DO MONEY TOO, WITHOUT BEING MADE TO: churnfolk money needs NO institution, lattice money is NOTHING BUT institution. Umbral's unspoken favor works only because it is UNRECORDED; lattice's registered claim works only because it IS recorded. Marcher sells oaths of arms; Stillhold sells the guarantee that violence will NOT happen — and Stillhold country will not honour a Marcher oath, on principle.

⚠️ THE BEST DERIVED CURRENCY IS STILLHOLD'S HELD PEACE: you buy the ABSENCE of something. Its value RISES as a region worsens, which means the Stillhold grow rich exactly where they are failing. An economy with a built-in tragedy, and nobody designed it — it fell out of the rule.

TWO CURRENCIES CANNOT BE STOLEN and it is worth knowing which: somatic's TRAINED FORM (portable only inside the person who learned it) and numinous's ATTENDED HOUR (which cannot leave the Reach at all). A bandit can take everything a party owns and not touch either.

AND IT RETROACTIVELY EXPLAINS MY OWN VILLAINY PASS: the licence trade forges SERAPHIC CHARTERS — which are that pole's actual currency. The Kindness runs on THRENODIST CARRIED GRIEF. The salvage rings deal ENGINEWRIGHT WORKING PARTS. I authored those trades from 'crime follows gates' before this rule existed, and they landed on the same economics anyway. That is the world being consistent underneath both passes.
